required_fixes: Add a one-sentence purpose/overview statement at the start of the 'Business model and value chain' subsection explaining how climate-related risks and opportunities are considered across the business model and value chain.

Introduce the climate risk register reference with a lead-in sentence that uses standards-aligned verbs (e.g., 'We identify and record climate-related risks in a climate risk register, which is mapped to IFRS S2 requirements, including paragraph 25(a)').
Clarify, in brief neutral language, what IFRS S2 §25(a) relates to (e.g., type of climate-related risks or exposures) so the reference is decision-useful rather than purely technical.

Reposition the technical evidence reference (climate_risk_register[0–7]...) as traceability metadata, either in a footnote, appendix, or clearly labelled evidence box, rather than as core narrative text.

Add a short connectivity sentence at the end of the subsection linking the climate risk register and value-chain view to other Strategy subsections and/or Risk Management (e.g., 'Refer to [Section: Risk Management] for how these registered risks are assessed and managed').

Consider adding a compact table or figure that maps climate-related risks from the register to value-chain segments and strategic themes, with a numbered caption and explicit reference in the narrative.
